snippet.title: Trails | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
✨ Out Now! Get TRAILS on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3605120/Trails/

TRAILS is a cozy puzzle game where you plot routes for floating sandships. Deliver vital cargo to remote outposts - without collisions, dead ends, or backtracking. Every move counts in the wasteland.

✨Trails Website✨
https://purplesloth.studio/games/trails/

🎵Music🎵
HoliznaCC0 - Sailing Away

Moore and Gardner - Chinese Blues (1916, George Gershwin piano roll)
